name: Audit finding closure evidence
summary: When an owner says an audit finding is fixed, the compliance lead gets the finding, the promised actions and the records supplied side by side: what each promise is backed by, what is missing and the questions to settle first. The auditor or the compliance lead decides whether it closes.

sources.title: Fully Powered AI's own published map of compliance work: preparing the evidence to close an audit finding, written without third-party text.
